notes: Manufacturer product page (clearone.com/bma-ct-1) and official datasheet PDFs (clearone.com/sites/default/files/...) returned 404/blocked to automated fetch, so I relied on a reputable AV retailer's detailed spec page (VideoLink) corroborated by search-result snippets pulling from the same ClearOne datasheet data (B&H listing, AV-iQ). No AC/DC power inlet exists — the unit is PoE-only (802.3at, 36W max), so no separate power port is listed. The two RJ45 jacks (P-Link In/Out) use ClearOne's proprietary P-Link protocol for daisy-chaining and control, not standard Ethernet networking, so no eth-* grade was assigned per the grading rules (grade omitted, connector kept as rj45 since it's the closest physical-connector match). Category set to "audio"/type "Microphone" since this is fundamentally a ceiling mic array (with an integrated small amp as a convenience feature) rather than a full AV receiver or amplifier product. Not rack-mountable (ceiling-tile form factor), so rackUnits omitted. Physical/mounting variant note: available in 24-inch, 600mm, and 625mm ceiling-grid sizes plus hard-ceiling mount, all sharing the same port set.

ports.name: P-Link In
ports.note: Proprietary P-Link network port; also carries PoE power in (IEEE 802.3at, 56V/640mA/36W) selectable via rear slide switch. Not standard Ethernet, so no eth-* grade applies.

ports.name: P-Link Out
ports.note: Proprietary P-Link daisy-chain port to next array unit (up to 3 units, 200m/650ft per hop).

ports.name: Amplifier Output
ports.note: 5.08mm Phoenix-type Euroblock, 2-channel, 2x10W into 8-ohm load, for driving two loudspeakers directly.
